title: FakeNet hybrid link messages, version 1
description: Messages between the Rust nucleus and the Camel daemon, over WebSocket (many in flight, correlated by request_id) or one-shot HTTP POST. Additive changes keep version 1; anything else bumps it.

Event.description: Something the malware sent, from the nucleus to the daemon. Every event that expects a reply has a request_id; notifications (expects_reply false) never get one.

request_id.description: Unique per event, echoed in its Action (UUID)

session_id.description: One per TCP connection, or per UDP (peer, port) flow; stable across a multi-step exchange

seq.description: The event's position within its session

protocol.description: The protocol detected by the sniffer

dst.description: Original destination address the malware connected to, ip:port (or the listener's, if not diverted)

process.description: The local process, when known (SingleHost diversion)

payload.description: The raw bytes received for this step (an HTTP request, a DNS query, a TCP chunk...)

meta.description: Protocol fields parsed by the nucleus, so routes needn't parse payloads: http {method, path, host, headers}, dns {qname, qtype}, smtp {command}, ...

expects_reply.description: False for notifications (e.g. a connection closed), which the daemon must not answer

Action.description: How to answer one event, from the daemon to the nucleus. A missing or null response means: use the nucleus's built-in default response.

response.description: Bytes to send. http: a complete raw HTTP/1.1 response. dns: UTF-8 lines 'TYPE VALUE' (e.g. 'A 10.6.6.6', 'TXT hello', 'NXDOMAIN'). raw/others: sent as-is.

delay_ms.description: Wait before replying (simulating slow C2). Not counted against the nucleus's decision deadline.

route.description: Which route decided, for the event log

Hello.title: Hello
Hello.description: The WebSocket handshake on an authenticated link: the nucleus sends a random nonce first; the daemon answers with the same nonce and auth = HMAC over "fakenet-link-v1 hello\n{nonce}". Nothing else is sent on the connection until it verifies.
